changelog: Modern Nimbus Emerald Glass UI with dual dark & light mode support
Fixed dark mode rendering and contrast across all management modules
Automated Cloudflare DNS A-record creation for subdomains when root domain is connected
Polished global animations for search bars, modals, page transitions, and emerald glass dropdown menus
Resolved Node.js installation issue by bundling 'n' runtime manager and adding failure detection
commands: sudo cp /usr/local/nimbus/scripts/n /usr/local/bin/n 2>/dev/null && sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/n 2>/dev/null && sudo ln -sf /usr/local/bin/n /usr/bin/n 2>/dev/null || true
